_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits inside Denial band with coil base rate dominant; bottom analog describes what may follow later, not a present break of the 32-38 range.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on phase Denial and non-directional stance; narrative supplies no competing forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear/composite holds 32-38 and BTC stays rangebound across next 12h windows without a trend day through the 30d drawdown
next_move.invalidated_if: Decisive composite break through 31 (Panic) or 39 (Anxiety), or next-day move beyond ~-2.3% that the thin Mon/first-3 lean only hints at
